On this week's Jeopardy, the first contestant was a physician, the second contestant was a taxi driver, and the third contestant's profession wasn't revealed. The taxi driver quickly outpaced both of the other contestants, and the physician did the worst, only getting two questions right. Who lost Jeopardy?
A. The taxi driver
B. The physician
C. Not answerable
